parrafo.es: The Purple Dog Spa is a mobile grooming service in Miami: a fully equipped van comes to your home so your dog or cat gets bathed, trimmed and groomed without the stress of a waiting room.
parrafo.en: The Purple Dog Spa is a mobile grooming service in Miami: a fully equipped van comes to your home so your dog or cat gets bathed, trimmed and groomed without the stress of a waiting room.

hero.imagen_alt: The Purple Dog Spa mobile grooming van parked outside in Miami

parrafo_1.es: The Purple Dog Spa is a mobile grooming service built around one idea: your pet is calmer at home. The van carries everything a full grooming studio would, a tub, a table and clippers, so there is no car ride and no waiting room for your dog or cat.
parrafo_1.en: The Purple Dog Spa is a mobile grooming service built around one idea: your pet is calmer at home. The van carries everything a full grooming studio would, a tub, a table and clippers, so there is no car ride and no waiting room for your dog or cat.

parrafo_2.es: Reviewers keep naming the same groomer, Jhoanna, for the same reasons: punctual, patient with nervous pets, and careful with the details, from a Mini Schnauzer's haircut to a flea treatment on a cat.
parrafo_2.en: Reviewers keep naming the same groomer, Jhoanna, for the same reasons: punctual, patient with nervous pets, and careful with the details, from a Mini Schnauzer's haircut to a flea treatment on a cat.

items.quote: Jhoanna is the best groomer in Miami, hands down. She gives my Mini Schnauzer a perfect haircut every single time. She is professional, has a spotless work space, and most importantly she loves what she does.
Jhoanna did such an amazing job grooming my baby! My 4 month old poodle is clean, trimmed and so handsome! She offers mobile services and comes to you, which is super convenient!

I booked a mobile grooming service for my cat and it was a great experience. The groomer came on time, was very professional and handled my cat with care. He did a neat haircut and solved the flea problem.
